note: WAEC Government round 3 (Round 23 top-up): authority vs power vs legitimacy, sovereignty, the state's four marks, nation, political socialisation, devolution, unwritten and rigid constitutions, legislative oversight, judicial independence, bicameralism, parliamentary fusion, two-party and multi-party systems, First Republic regional parties, first-past-the-post vs proportional representation, universal adult suffrage, pressure-group methods and trade unions, Richards 1946 regionalism, Macpherson 1951, Lyttleton 1954 federation, 1960 independence, 1963 republic, 1979 presidential system and the two-thirds clause, NNDP 1923, NCNC 1944, Egbe Omo Oduduwa and the AG, Zik's newspapers, London-Lagos conferences, coups and decrees, 1976 local government reforms, Afrocentrism, OAU role, non-alignment and technical aid as soft power. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-2, NECO Government and the JAMB Government pool.
